verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers authorization controls to set rules on how/where issued cards can be used, and marketing mentions 'Spend Controls' for corporate cards, plus a broader Spend module for controlling company spend across expenses and payables. However, there's no explicit documentation of department/program-level budget allocation with automatic enforcement of spend limits (vs. per-card authorization rules) — missing for 10: explicit department/program budget-setting feature, documented automatic limit enforcement tied to org hierarchy, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific budgeting workflow.
